rooms.name: Main Corridor
rooms.notes: Corridor that appears to run the length of the ship

rooms.name: Forest
rooms.notes:
Massive forest area. Contains many strange plants and animals, some of which may be edible. There is also a small river that is a source of drinkable water.

An artificial tree projects an illusory dryad that seems to have information about the ship.

rooms.name: Small Greenhouse
rooms.notes: A small greenhouse containing medicinal herbs. Once the lair of a basilisk, several petrified victims are present here.

rooms.name: Memory Theater
rooms.notes: Theater that reads the audience's memories and displays them on a screen.

rooms.name: Orrery
rooms.notes: An orrery of a strange, alien solar system.

rooms.name: Small Hallway above Orrery
rooms.notes: A short hallway with a heavy metal door at one end and a spiral staircase down at the other end. A smaller metal door is on each of side of the hallway.

rooms.name: Restoration Engine
rooms.notes: A massive arcane device submerged in a pool of liquid.

rooms.name: Porcelain Passageways
rooms.notes: Sprawling halls of tiles and tubs. Strange fluids flow from faucets in the walls.

rooms.name: Quartermaster's Bazaar
rooms.notes: T-shaped hallway filled with dozens of vending machines. A shrine to Kleb Rosh-Nak sits at the intersection point.

connections.notes: Heavy metal door, can be barred a control panel in the Porcelain Passageways

connections.notes: A spiral staircase down, behind a plexiglass door

connections.notes: A circular hallway that seems to travel in an infinite circle. Going backwards leads to a solid wall

connections.name: Spiral Staircase
